race.title: Musselburgh Racecourse Premium Annual Membership Handicap Chase
race.verdict: FLASH DU PISTOLET has gradually edged back down to his last winning mark and can end his losing run with a recent outing behind him. Chasing debut winner Nevershedatear should go close in her attempt to follow up, whilst Humble Jumble isn't one to completely rule out. FLASH DU PISTOLET (IRE) NEVERSHEDATEAR (IRE) HUMBLE JUMBLE (IRE)
race.bettingForecast: Nevershedatear (1/1), Flash Du Pistolet (11/2), Too Cool Forshrule (6/1), Huit Reflets (7/1), Carcaci Castle (8/1), Humble Jumble (10/1)
